summary.verdict: All five TDD Anchor tests are present and meaningful. Pyramid level is correct (pure unit — no Spring context). Coverage of the contract this task introduces is complete.

roundTripsTriggerArray.quality: GOOD — serializes UpdateFunnelRequest with 3 elements covering all shapes (on_start/event/keyword), deserializes back, and asserts triggerType, triggerValue, entryStepId, and keywords field-by-field. No vacuous assertions.

deserializeIgnoresUnknownProperties.quality: GOOD — fires a hostile JSON body that smuggles 'status' at the top level AND 'bogus' inside TriggerDto. Asserts the deserialization succeeds and the known field is readable, which proves @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown=true) is wired on BOTH UpdateFunnelRequest and TriggerDto. Comment is accurate.

funnelResponseRoundTrip.quality: GOOD — covers FunnelResponse AND FunnelSummaryResponse in one test, with entryStepId and triggerValue both verified after round-trip. Covers the two remaining DTO shapes the task spec requires.

sizeCapViolationFlaggedByValidator.quality: GOOD — builds a list of MAX_TRIGGERS+1 elements, runs the programmatic Validator, and asserts the violation path is 'triggers'. Proves the @Size annotation is present and the Validator is wired.

sizeCapBoundaryAccepted.note: Not listed in the TDD Anchor but present as a bonus. Exactly MAX_TRIGGERS elements must pass — this is the off-by-one boundary test that the spec says to include in the @Size cap coverage ('violation + boundary'). Its presence is correct and valuable.

validCascadesIntoTriggerDto.quality: GOOD — creates a TriggerDto with keywords.size() == MAX_KEYWORDS+1, validates the parent UpdateFunnelRequest, and asserts the violation path starts with 'triggers[0].keywords'. Proves @Valid cascade is wired end-to-end, not just that the annotation compiles.

summary.pyramid_level: CORRECT — pure unit tests. ObjectMapper instantiated directly; Validator built via Validation.buildDefaultValidatorFactory(). No Spring context, no mocking. Test executes in milliseconds. @BeforeAll/@AfterAll properly open/close the ValidatorFactory to avoid resource leak.
summary.assertion_quality: All assertions are on real values (triggerType, triggerValue, entryStepId, keywords, violation paths). No mock-call-only assertions, no trivially-true expects.
summary.scope_compliance: The test correctly does NOT cover: duplicate event_name rejection, entryStepId resolution, onStartTriggerValue sync — all deferred to Task 4. The javadoc states this explicitly.
